The network averaged 36,581 daily flights in Week 35, up 0.6% compared to Week 34 and 2.3% higher than in 2025.

Arrival punctuality fell by 2.7pp to 69.0%, while departure punctuality decreased by 0.4pp to 63.6%.

Total air traffic flow management (ATFM) delay per flight was 4.2 mins/flight (3.4 for en-route and 0.8 for airport).
